title: Units
description: content/battles/<id>/units.json: every unit marker in the battle. PLAN.md section 8.7. Positions are not stored here; they're in phases.json.

id.description: Prefix with the side, e.g. us-pickens-militia, gb-dragoons.

subgroup.description: A subgroup id from battle.json sides[].subgroups.

type.description: Sets the map symbol: infantry X, cavalry slash, artillery dot (PLAN.md 8.5).

strengthNote.description: e.g. “about 50”. Put the figure in a fact and list it in factIds too.

frontage.description: Width of the battle line in field units.

looseOrder.description: Skirmishers: drawn as a dotted line.
